The reference doc sets two columns, so Word keeps a normal figure and the
render prints one warning. Run `python3 tests/reference_narrow.py` first,
or `python3 tests/verify.py`, which writes the reference docs.

![A figure in a two-column document.](plot.png){#fig-columns .wrap-right width="40%"}
